about: T-483 / T-482 / T-486: THE HERMETIC LAYER in the game. With the book held at 3 AM (DEBUG's WATCH, gDaemonsWatchOverride 5) the map breathes red to blue through purple and the follower shimmers on the same breath; on Halloween (DEBUG's DATE, gDaemonsDateOverride 10, MASK NIGHT) by day the follower wears a costume and A takes it off; by day the book will not open; at night it opens on its cover, then its warning, and the first page turned past the warning glitches once; at 3 AM in a wild battle the ground breathes. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
